plan.title: Fix Authentication Issue on Articles Settings Page

problem_summary.issue: 401 Unauthorized error on /settings/articles page due to redundant client-side authentication checks
problem_summary.root_cause: AuthGuard.svelte makes unnecessary checkAuth() calls even when user is already authenticated via SSR
problem_summary.impact: Buttons non-functional, preventing CRUD operations on articles

solution_strategy.approach: Remove redundant client-side authentication verification and trust SSR authentication data
solution_strategy.principle: Avoid duplicate API calls when authentication state is already established

step.title: Analyze Current AuthGuard Logic
step.description: Review the current authentication flow in AuthGuard.svelte to identify redundant calls
step.current_issue: Lines 32-42 in AuthGuard.svelte call authStore.checkAuth() even when user is authenticated from localStorage, causing unnecessary API calls that fail due to different session context between SSR and client-side

step.title: Modify AuthGuard to Trust SSR Data
step.description: Update AuthGuard.svelte to trust SSR authentication data and avoid redundant verification

change.description: Remove unnecessary checkAuth() call when user is already authenticated from localStorage
change.rationale: If user is authenticated from localStorage and SSR provides valid user data, no additional verification needed

change.description: Add logic to detect when SSR authentication is sufficient
change.rationale: Trust SSR data when available to avoid redundant API calls

change.description: Only call checkAuth() when there's no SSR data and no stored authentication
change.rationale: Maintain authentication check only when truly necessary

step.expected_outcome: Elimination of 401 errors on pages with SSR authentication

step.title: Enhance Auth Store to Handle SSR Context
step.description: Improve auth.store.ts to better handle SSR authentication data without redundant verification

change.description: Add flag to track SSR authentication status
change.rationale: Distinguish between SSR-authenticated and client-authenticated users

change.description: Modify checkAuth() to respect SSR authentication flag
change.rationale: Avoid redundant API calls when SSR has already validated the session

step.title: Add Comprehensive Testing
step.description: Create tests to verify the authentication fix works correctly across different scenarios

scenario.name: SSR Authentication with Valid Session
scenario.description: Test that articles page loads without 401 errors when user authenticated via SSR
scenario.expected_result: No API calls to /auth/me, buttons functional

scenario.name: Client-side Authentication Fall-back
scenario.description: Test that authentication still works when SSR data is not available

scenario.name: Invalid Session Handling
scenario.description: Test that invalid sessions are properly handled without causing errors

step.title: Edge Cases and Error Handling
step.description: Address edge cases and improve error handling

case.name: Session Expiry During Page Load
case.solution: Implement graceful session expiry detection and redirect

case.name: Network Connectivity Issues
case.solution: Add retry logic with exponential backoff for network failures

case.name: Malformed SSR Data
case.solution: Validate SSR data integrity before trusting it

case.name: Admin Role Verification
case.solution: Ensure admin role is preserved during authentication flows

step.title: Performance Optimization
step.description: Optimize authentication performance by reducing unnecessary API calls

optimization.name: Reduce API Call Frequency
optimization.description: Eliminate redundant /auth/me calls when authentication state is known

optimization.name: Faster Page Load
optimization.description: Remove authentication delay on SSR-authenticated pages
optimization.expected_improvement: 200-500ms faster page load for authenticated users

optimization.name: Better User Experience
optimization.description: Eliminate loading states for already-authenticated users
